---
title: "AI Use Guidelines"
---

AI can support learning, debugging, and code review, but the analyst remains responsible for every conclusion.

Use AI to:

- Explain unfamiliar R code.
- Translate error messages into possible causes.
- Draft first-pass code for review.
- Suggest checks for assumptions.
- Improve comments, captions, and report language.

Do not use AI to:

- Replace inspecting the data.
- Invent columns or assumptions.
- Accept code that has not been run.
- Explain results without checking outputs.
- Make actuarial judgements without human review.
